pages.text:
An automatic crafting table (Tempered tier). Set a recipe in its 3×3 pattern: click a cell with an item to copy it there (the item isn't used), or press JEI's + on any crafting recipe.
- Ingredients go into its 18-slot buffer; it only accepts items the pattern uses. Each craft takes 400 FE and 1 second.
- The result goes to the output slot. Leftovers such as empty buckets go to the two slots beside it.
- Takes Speed and Energy upgrades. Output faces send out results and leftovers.
